children: Prosecutors in Belgium said they held a man with dual Chinese and Belgian nationality in pre-trial detention on suspicion of espionage in a case involving semiconductor technology.
The prosecutors said the 52-year old man, who lives in Belgium, was arrested in May at Belgium's Zaventem airport, before boarding a flight to Beijing.
He used to work for Belgium microchip maker BELGAN BV which was declared bankrupt on July 31, 2024, the prosecutors said in a statement.
